translations.ivision-page.around.body: Your IDEM account is enough: the same wallet and the same prices as in your dashboard. iVision makes the business known — the rest of the business is the rest of IDEM.
translations.ivision-page.around.title: One account, one wallet
translations.ivision-page.brand.lede: Paste your site’s address. iVision reads its colours, its fonts, its logo and its tone, and uses them from the next creation onwards. A brand is never required: you can produce a video with no project, no charter and no logo.
translations.ivision-page.brand.title: Your website becomes your brand guide
translations.ivision-page.capabilities.title: What it does that a template cannot
translations.ivision-page.capability.creativity.descr: Four notches, from a plain composition to a real piece of authored work. The notch picks the range of templates it draws from.
translations.ivision-page.capability.creativity.title: A gauge for how far it goes
translations.ivision-page.capability.formats.descript: The same film laid out for a feed, a story and a screen. You do not reframe anything by hand.
translations.ivision-page.capability.formats.title: Every format, one request
translations.ivision-page.capability.montage.descript: Import a video of you talking. iVision cuts the silences and the hesitations, adds the subtitles, and makes what you say appear on screen.
translations.ivision-page.capability.montage.title: Film yourself, it edits
translations.ivision-page.capability.photos.descripti: No filter, no duotone, no tracing. What you upload is what is shown — a check in the code makes sure of it.
translations.ivision-page.capability.photos.title: Your photos stay your photos
translations.ivision-page.capability.stencil.descript: A video or a poster you like? Add it. iVision takes its cutting, its movements and its composition — with your texts, your images and your music.
translations.ivision-page.capability.stencil.title: Show it a model, it copies it
translations.ivision-page.capability.voice.descriptio: Dictate your request. It is transcribed on our own machines — the recording never leaves for a third party, and it is deleted as soon as the text exists.
translations.ivision-page.capability.voice.title: Speak instead of typing
translations.ivision-page.ecosystem.icode.description: The website or the application the videos point to — written from the same brand.
translations.ivision-page.ecosystem.idem.description: Brand charter, business plan, communication calendar. A charter made in IDEM is imported into iVision in one click.
translations.ivision-page.ecosystem.idem.name: The IDEM platform
translations.ivision-page.hero.lede: One sentence is enough. iVision makes the motion design video or the visual, in your colours, sized for every network — and you change it by clicking on it.
translations.ivision-page.step.brand.description: Paste your website’s address and iVision reads its colours, fonts, logo and tone. No site? « In blue and gold » in your request does the job.
translations.ivision-page.step.brand.title: It takes your colours
translations.ivision-page.step.edit.description: Click any text: the video jumps to the moment it appears and changes while you type. Do not like a photo? Replace it in one click.
translations.ivision-page.step.edit.title: Click, write, it is changed
translations.ivision-page.step.publish.description: Every network format at once, or the file on your machine. Nothing is published until you have approved it.
translations.ivision-page.step.publish.title: Publish, or download
translations.ivision-page.step.say.description: « A video for our end-of-year sale: 30 % off the whole shop, until 31 December. » One sentence is enough — written, or dictated.
translations.ivision-page.step.say.title: Say what you want to announce
translations.ivision-page.step.watch.description: Shots appear one after another, with their text, their images and their music. You see the film before it is finished.
translations.ivision-page.step.watch.title: Watch it get made
translations.ivision-page.steps.body: There is no timeline to learn and no software to install. The first sentence is the first step, and nothing is published without you.
translations.ivision-page.steps.title: How a request goes
translations.ivision-page.workshop.image.description: Posters, posts, stories, banners — composed to the millimetre and checked by eye before they are handed to you.
translations.ivision-page.workshop.image.title: Visuals
translations.ivision-page.workshop.video.description: Motion design from 6 to 60 seconds, with royalty-free music and sound effects. Or your own piece to camera, edited for you.
translations.ivision-page.workshop.video.title: Videos
translations.ivision-page.workshops.lede: One conversation makes visuals, another makes videos. Each keeps its own settings and its own history, so a poster never inherits a film’s choices.
translations.ivision-page.workshops.title: Two workshops, never mixed
